title: Pullback of the shifted finite-line evaluation and right unit
statement: For a commutative coefficient ring A killed by N>0, any normalized positive transport t, and any scheme morphism f:X->Y with N invertible on Y, the canonical evaluation K_Y tensor L_Y -> A_Y of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-decomposition-maps] pulls back to evaluation on X via the canonical tensor, negative-twist, positive-twist and constant comparisons. For every unbounded complex K on Y the inverse right-unit map commutes with the same tensor and constant comparisons. These are exactly the two equations in the Lean statement and require no properness or finiteness of A.

proof.text: Apply the sheaf negative-evaluation and product-pullback normalizations in [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. Normalized positive transport agrees with t by [lem-amb-ordinary-finite-twist-transport-uniqueness]. The flat degree-zero tensor and single-object pullback comparisons are induced by the same complexes, so their square commutes. Move symmetry past pullback and apply tensor-shift compatibility with shifts -2 and 2; shift-zero coherence gives the evaluation square.

The constant degree-zero object is the monoidal unit via singleFunctorObjUnitIso. Its pullback comparison is the monoidal unit comparison. Oplax right unitality, followed by naturality of this unit identification, gives the second equation.

theorem finiteTwistDerivedEvaluation_pullback
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤))) :
    ((ordinaryFinitePullback A f).map (p1DecompositionEvaluation A N hN hA Y hY) ≫
      (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A f).hom =
      ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app
        (p1DecompositionTwist A N hA Y (-1) (-2))).app
          ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA Y)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≫
        ((ordinaryFiniteTensor A X).obj
          ((ordinaryFinitePullback A f).obj (p1DecompositionTwist A N hA Y (-1) (-2)))).map
            (ordinaryFiniteShiftedLinePullback A N hA t f hY).hom ≫
        ((ordinaryFiniteTensor A X).map
          (p1DecompositionTwistPullback A N hN hA f hY (-1) (-2)).hom).app _ ≫
        p1DecompositionEvaluation A N hN hA X
          ((map_natCast f.appTop.hom N) ▸ hY.map f.appTop.hom)) ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y,
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A f).map (derivedTensorSingleUnitIso K).inv ≫
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app K).app
          (ordinaryFiniteUnit A Y) ≫
        ((ordinaryFiniteTensor A X).obj ((ordinaryFinitePullback A f).obj K)).map
          (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A f).hom =
      (derivedTensorSingleUnitIso ((ordinaryFinitePullback A f).obj K)).inv)
